wonders.description: cityBonusScaled; 500 ~= 5% city-wide. No gold/diamond production rewards.

commerce.description: Commerces earn cash on a fixed rewardSec cycle. Payout scales with construction cost (same timer/collect loop as houses).

rent.description: Houses earn rent via signed contracts. Sign (pay costBase) → wait → collect incomeBase boosted by house contractBonusPercent.
